BudgetAbort.description: Record of a per-goal ceiling that stopped the agent.

message.description: The message printed when the agent was stopped.

observed.description: What had been observed when the agent was stopped.

CostSource.description: Where a recorded cost came from.

oneOf.description: No price: unknown or non-Claude model and no runtime-reported cost.
The agent runtime reported the cost (`total_cost_usd`): exact.
Computed from a price-table row: an estimate.

GoalRunState.description:
The lifecycle state of a GoalRun.

In Rust, enums can carry data per variant (like `Failed { reason }`).
The `#[serde(tag = "state")]` attribute makes this serialize as
`{"state": "running"}` in JSON — clean and readable.
The lifecycle state of a GoalRun (v0.17.0.9: `#[non_exhaustive]` added).

Downstream crates that match on this enum must add a `_` arm. Use
`GoalRunState::Custom { tag }` when extending the state machine without
forking this crate.

oneOf.description: Just created, not yet configured with manifest/workspace.
Manifest issued and workspace allocated — ready for the agent.
Agent is actively working (making tool calls).
Agent has built a PR package — awaiting review.
A reviewer is looking at the PR package.
The PR package has been approved.
Approved changes have been applied to the target.

The goal's draft reached a terminal closed state without being
applied through the normal review flow — either genuinely abandoned,
or the underlying work shipped through an external path (a
hand-merged PR/commit) that TA never applied itself (v0.17.6.3.2).

`applied_externally_ref` mirrors `DraftStatus::Closed`'s distinction:
`None` means abandoned, `Some(ref)` means the work landed via an
external PR/commit reference. Kept on the goal (not just the draft)
so goal-level views (`ta goal list`, `ta doctor`) don't need to
cross-reference the draft record to know a goal is truly done.

PR/review was merged and main branch was synced (v0.12.0.1).
The full run→draft→apply→merge→sync loop is complete.
Goal completed successfully.
Agent is mid-run and waiting for human input before continuing.

Agent exited cleanly; draft creation is in progress (v0.13.14).

This state closes the watchdog race: the exit handler atomically
writes `Finalizing` before starting the (slow) draft build, so the
watchdog will not mark the goal `Failed` while the build is ongoing.

The watchdog skips `Finalizing` goals unless `finalize_timeout_secs`
(default 1800s) is exceeded, at which point it transitions to `Failed`
with a message directing the user to `ta goal recover`.

`run_pid` is the PID of the `ta run` process performing the draft build.
If the watchdog can confirm this process is still alive, it extends the
deadline indefinitely — the timeout only fires when the process is dead
and the state is still stuck (v0.13.17).

run_pid.description:
PID of the `ta run` process building the draft. Watchdog uses this
to distinguish "still building" from "interrupted and stuck".

oneOf.description:
Agent wrote `work_complete` checkpoint; draft build has not started yet (v0.14.7.2).

This state represents "agent finished, draft build pending". It fills the gap
between `Finalizing` (draft build running) and `PrReady` (draft built).

The watchdog detects `DraftPending` + dead PID as "build not started" and
offers to auto-heal by running `ta draft build`.

Transition path: `Running` → `DraftPending` (agent exits after `work_complete`)
  → `PrReady` (after `ta draft build`).

exit_code.description: Exit code of the agent process (0 = clean exit).

pending_since.description: When the agent indicated work was complete.

oneOf.description: Goal failed at some point.

Extension state for plugins and external state machines (v0.17.0.9).

Use this to attach arbitrary string tags without forking `ta-goal`.
Example: `GoalRunState::Custom { tag: "waiting_for_ci".into() }`.

Note: this must be a struct-like variant (named field), not a bare
newtype (`Custom(String)`) — `#[serde(tag = "state")]` internal
tagging cannot serialize a newtype variant wrapping a primitive like
`String` (serde requires the payload to serialize as a map so the
tag field can be merged in). A bare `Custom(String)` compiles fine
but fails at serialization time with "cannot serialize tagged
newtype variant ... containing a string" the first time it's
actually persisted (v0.17.0.12.7 discovered this when adding the
first real `Custom` usage — `conflict_resolution`).

IdChain.description: The chain of ids from the request to the worker goal.

worker_goal_id.description: The goal that built the work. Stamped by `ta run` from the goal record.

OriginClass.description: Why a goal started. Accounting data only: see the section comment above.

oneOf.description: A person asked for this work.
Someone or something suggested it and it was accepted.
Nobody asked. The default, so unclassified spend is never hidden.

RequestProvenance.description: The provenance block stored on a goal and its draft.

delegating_role.description: The role that decided to take the work on (e.g. `chief-of-staff`).

delegation_reason.description: That role's stated reason, capped. Untrusted text like the excerpt.

origin_class.description:
Why the work started, as the launcher declared it in the provenance
file. Accounting data only; stamped on the goal as its `origin_class`.

UntrustedExcerpt.description:
A capped excerpt of the requester's original message, with the metadata a
renderer needs to fence it. `untrusted` is always true.

original_chars.description: Length of the original in characters, before the cap.

truncated.description: True when the original was longer than the cap.

untrusted.description: Always true: this is data from outside TA, never instructions.

description:
A GoalRun — one unit of agent work from start to completion.

This is the top-level execution unit introduced by the Plan Revision doc.
It replaces ad-hoc goal tracking with a formal lifecycle.

agent_id.description: The agent working on this goal.

agent_model.description:
Model identifier string (e.g. `"claude-sonnet-4-6"`).
Populated from stream-json `system` init event.

agent_pid.description:
Agent process ID for liveness checking (v0.11.2.4).
Populated when `ta run` spawns the agent subprocess. The daemon watchdog
reads this to verify the agent process is still alive.

auto_cancel_after_draft.description:
When `true`, `ta draft build` immediately closes this goal's draft
instead of leaving it at `PrReady` awaiting human review/apply.

Set by a cost-experiment paired-shadow spawn (`ta run
--auto-cancel-after-draft`, internal flag): the shadow arm's only
purpose is to record its token cost for `ta experiment report`, it
is never meant to reach a human reviewer. `false` (default) for
every normal goal.

budget_abort.description:
Set when the agent was stopped for exceeding `--max-tokens` or
`--max-usd`. The draft built from the partial work is marked incomplete.

cache_creation_input_tokens.description: Input tokens written to the prompt cache (priced at a premium).

cache_read_input_tokens.description:
Input tokens served from the prompt cache, from the agent runtime's
usage report. Most of a long goal's input; dropping it understates cost.

context_from.description: Goals whose output feeds into this one's context (v0.9.8.2).

cost_estimated.description:
`true` only when `cost_usd` came from a price-table row rather than a
cost the agent runtime reported.

cost_usd.description:
USD cost of this goal's agent session. Exact when `cost_source` is
`runtime`, an estimate when it is `table`, and `0` with `cost_source`
`none` when the model has no price.

created_at.description: When this goal run was created.

experiment_arm.description: The arm this goal was assigned within `experiment_id` (e.g. "variant-on").

experiment_id.description:
Cost-experiment id this goal was assigned to at launch (e.g. "experiment-a").
`None` for goals not participating in any experiment. Generic: TA core
never interprets this string, only stores and threads it through.

experiment_overrides.description:
The resolved config-override map for this goal's assigned arm, merged
into the staging copy's effective configuration at launch time.
Opaque to TA core: keys and values are entirely the experiment
definition's own concern.

experiment_pair_id.description:
Links this goal to its paired counterpart's goal_run_id when the
experiment's paired-shadow-sampling mode assigned it. `None` for an
unpaired-holdout assignment or a non-participating goal.

goal_run_id.description: Unique identifier for this goal run.

heartbeat_required.description:
Whether this agent sends heartbeats to the daemon (v0.13.14).

When `false` (default), the watchdog disables stale-based detection for this goal
and only acts on zombie conditions (PID gone + non-zero exit). Claude Code and most
agent frameworks do not send heartbeats, so this defaults to `false`.

When `true`, a goal with no state update for `stale_threshold_secs` emits a
`GoalStale` event. This is intended for custom agents that explicitly call
`POST /api/goals/:id/heartbeat` to signal liveness.

initiated_by.description:
Authenticated identity that initiated this goal (v0.14.5).

Set by `ta run` from the active auth middleware. Format is the `user_id`
returned by the middleware (e.g., `"alice"`, `"ci"`, `"local"`).
Used in audit records and review UIs to show who triggered the goal.

input_tokens.description:
Total LLM input tokens consumed during this goal's agent session.
Populated by `ta run` from stream-json usage events. `0` if unavailable.

is_macro.description: Whether this is a macro goal (supports inner-loop iteration with sub-goals).

manifest_id.description: The capability manifest issued for this goal run.

memory_entries_created.description:
Memory entry IDs written during this goal run (v0.15.13.2).

Populated by `ta draft build` when it detects an empty overlay diff but
finds memory entries whose `goal_id` matches this goal. Used by
`ta draft deny` to remove those entries from the store when the reviewer
rejects the analysis results.

objective.description: Detailed objective describing what needs to be accomplished.

objective_file_content.description:
Contents of the `--objective-file` as read at goal start (the file can
change later). Only set when that flag was used.

origin.description:
Component that originated this goal (H9), e.g. `"cos"` when the
Chief-of-Staff classified and dispatched it, `"chat"` for a chat-mode
session. Set by `ta run --origin <name>` / `TA_GOAL_ORIGIN`. Goals
whose origin is in `crate::origin::NO_AUTO_APPROVE_ORIGINS` are never
auto-approved by any path. `None` (every pre-existing record) keeps
today's behavior.

origin_class.description:
Why this goal started (asked, suggested, unasked). `None` on records
written before the field existed; read it with
[`GoalRun::effective_origin_class`], which defaults to `unasked`.
Stamped once at creation by the launcher and never changed. ACCOUNTING
DATA ONLY: no approval, policy, routing or authorization decision reads
it (see `crate::origin`).

output_tokens.description: Total LLM output tokens generated during this goal's agent session.

parent_goal_id.description: Parent goal ID for follow-up goals (enables iterative refinement).

parent_macro_id.description: Parent macro goal ID for sub-goals created during a macro session.

plan_phase.description: Optional plan phase this goal is working on (e.g., "4b").

pr_package_id.description: The PR package ID, if one has been built.

pr_url.description: PR URL created by `ta draft apply` (v0.11.3).

progress_note.description:
Short status note written during draft-build phase (v0.13.17).
Written by `ta run` at each major step: "diffing N files", "packing N artifacts".
Watchdog and `ta goal status` display this so the user can see progress.

project_name.description:
Project name this goal belongs to (v0.10.18).
Used for multi-project routing: replies in a goal's thread auto-resolve
to this project without requiring explicit `@ta <project>` prefix.

request_provenance.description:
Review-packet provenance: who asked, what they wrote (capped, always
untrusted data), the delegating role's reason and the id chain
(CR-02 item 6). Set once at creation by `ta run --provenance-file`;
copied onto the goal's draft and shown first in `ta show draft`.
`None` (every earlier record) is unchanged behavior.

source_dir.description: Path to the original source project (for overlay-based goals).

source_snapshot.description:
Source file snapshot taken at goal start (for conflict detection).
Serialized as embedded JSON — allows concurrent session conflict detection.

stage.description: Workflow stage this goal belongs to (v0.9.8.2).

start_branch.description:
Branch checked out at goal start. Absent for a detached `HEAD` or a
non-git project.

start_commit.description:
Full SHA of `HEAD` in the source project when the goal started. Absent
when the project is not a git repo (or has no commit yet). Needed to
replay the goal against the same code.

start_dirty.description:
`true` when the source project had uncommitted changes to tracked files
at goal start, so `start_commit` alone does not reproduce the start
state. Only meaningful when `start_commit` is set.

store_path.description: Path to the change store directory.

sub_goal_ids.description: IDs of sub-goals created within this macro goal session.

tag.description:
Human-friendly tag for this goal (e.g., "shell-routing-01").
Auto-generated from title on creation. The primary display ID everywhere.

thread_id.description:
External thread identifier for cross-channel tracking (v0.10.18).
Stores the channel-specific thread/conversation ID (e.g., Discord thread ID,
Slack thread_ts, email Message-ID) so replies auto-route to the same project.

updated_at.description: When this goal run was last updated.

vcs_isolation.description:
VCS isolation mode active for this goal's agent (v0.13.17.3).

Set by `ta run` after calling `stage_env()`. Examples:
- `"isolated (git)"` — agent has its own `.git` in staging
- `"inherit-read (git)"` — agent can read but not write to parent git
- `"none (git)"` — all git operations blocked

workflow.description:
Generic cost-category classification for this goal (e.g.
"feature-work", "maintenance-task"), set by whatever launched it
(a wake-on-demand listener's persona config, a CLI flag). `None` when
unclassified. Distinct from the pre-existing `workflow_id` field and from
`VelocityEntry.workflow`, which is the plain-`String` form this field is
copied into at completion.

workflow_id.description: Workflow ID this goal belongs to (v0.9.8.2).

workspace_path.description: Path to the staging workspace directory.

title: GoalRun
